A CLOSER LOOK / MATERIAL & DETAIL

Considered down
to the details.

Preparation, layout, and the finishing touches.
The little things deserve attention, too.

03 / WORKING TOGETHER

Care for the work.
Respect for your home.

A clear scope. A person to talk to.
Decisions made together, from the first conversation to the final walkthrough.

01

A clear point of contact.

Your on-site manager is your main contact for questions, decisions, and coordination throughout the work.

02

Scope and selections, together.

Before work begins, we review the scope with you in detail and provide a list of material options. For labor-and-materials projects, the selected materials inform the quote. For labor-only projects, you select and supply materials; we discuss any installation choices that affect labor pricing.

03

Protection before the work.

We select protection to suit the existing surfaces and work area: plastic sheeting, Ram Board floor protection, or adhesive carpet protection film where appropriate.

04

Changes agreed in writing.

When a change comes up, we discuss it with you on site. Once we agree on the change, we document it in a written change order. Any pricing or payment adjustments are discussed and agreed together.

05

A walkthrough before handover.

At completion, we walk through the work together, check the finishes, and test relevant functions. We review any remaining items with you before handover.

04 / THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE WORK

Good work.
Good people.
A better experience.

Your on-site manager is your main point of contact. Questions about the work, material choices, and changes start with a conversation with the person coordinating your project on site.

We discuss the scope with you in detail before work begins, so the work and the choices behind it are understood together.

When the project calls for an architect or interior designer, we collaborate with external professionals. This support is arranged around the needs of your project.
